items.text:
Now that it came out of early access, I feel as if I need to write a more current review.
The game is janky, but in a good way (in my opinion), even if they axed the (arguably) best way of making money by rebalancing the gigs and ferry, there's still many viable ways of playing the game and becoming rich without needing to salvage, which in my opinion makes the whole experience feel more complete and not like just a "go into dead ship simulator".
Even still, the game has plenty of drawbacks, like the character generation being absolute RNG and you either get the worst character imaginable or you get the .001% chance of getting the ultra gigachad

You usually start with a pretty steep mortgage, and the only thing that keeps moving you forward is that, and your greed, you might think the quests are meaningful but in reality most of them are just flavor text, most of the time you don't get great rewards for the quests, and after you get rid of your debt all there is to look forward to is buying bigger ships, and maybe getting a citizenship and a fancy apartment to go with it.

Most of the social needs are unbalanced, you get too little of it solved by interacting, and it climbs at a rate it's almost impossible to keep everything fine, you'll either feel too lonely, too selfish, too horny, or all of them at once 
This only makes the whole experience more daunting to new players, but luckily your psychological needs are just that, psychological.

There are plenty of other things that need to be ironed out, but that sort of jank and soul this game has makes me love it as much as I do.
items.text_zh:
既然它已经脱离抢先体验阶段，我觉得我需要写一篇更符合现状的评测。
这游戏很粗糙，但在我看来是好的那种粗糙，即使他们通过重新平衡任务和渡轮砍掉了（可以说是）最好的赚钱方式，仍然有很多可行的玩法可以让你在不靠打捞的情况下发财，在我看来这让整个体验感觉更完整，而不只是“进入死船模拟器”。
即便如此，这游戏还是有很多缺点，比如角色生成完全是随机的，你要么得到能想象到的最差角色，要么有0.001%的几率得到终极巨佬

你通常一开始就背着一笔相当沉重的房贷，而唯一推动你前进的就是它，以及你的贪婪，你可能以为那些任务很有意义，但实际上大多数只是背景文本，大多数时候你从任务中得不到很好的奖励，而等你摆脱债务之后，能期待的就只有买更大的船，也许再弄个公民身份和与之相配的高档公寓。

大多数社交需求都不平衡，通过互动解决的太少了，而它增长的速度几乎不可能让一切都保持良好，你要么觉得太孤独，要么太自私，要么太饥渴，要么这些同时出现
这只会让新玩家觉得整个体验更加令人望而生畏，但幸运的是你的心理需求就只是心理上的。

还有很多其他东西需要完善，但这款游戏拥有的那种粗糙和灵魂让我如此热爱它。

observations.description: 任务大多是 flavor text，奖励不佳
observations.evidence: most of them are just flavor text, most of the time you don't get great rewards for the quests
